tha-ap353:1.1: Ekapadumiyavaggo pañcatiṃso. [348. Saddasaññaka.] Migaluddo pure āsim araññe kānane ahaṃ / tatth' addasāsiṃ sambuddhaṃ devasaṅghapurakkhataṃ // //
tha-ap353:2.1: Catusaccaṃ pakāsentam uddharantaṃ mahājanaṃ / assosiṃ madhuraṃ vācaṃ karavīkarudopamaṃ. // //
tha-ap353:3.1: Brahmassarassa munino Sikhino lokabandhuno / ghose cittaṃ pasādetvā patto 'mhi āsavakkhayaṃ. // //
tha-ap353:4.1: Ekatiṃse ito kappe yaṃ kammam akariṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi pasādassa idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap353:6.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Saddasaññako thero i. g. a-ti.
